summary: TTM Technologies filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement on June 1, 2026. The agreement provides a $400.0 million senior secured term loan facility (repriced and upsized from $340.4 million outstanding, 50 bps spread reduction) and a new $1.0 billion senior secured revolving credit facility. Proceeds refinanced the prior term loan. Interest is Term SOFR + 1.75%. Quarterly principal repayments remain 1% annually; maturity May 30, 2030. No special-situation event.
